about: Arp Magic's page data for tools/build_packs.py: the pack's line, the families the page filters by, each sound (its file and clip name, family and one line), and the credits. The final pack of 23 November 2026 (RM INK research/arp-demo-pack-2026-11-22/FINAL.md, commit 9e8a2bd5a): 33 sounds in the pack's order (patches/order.json), 4 kits.
line: 33 arp sounds: pianos, harps, guitars, mallets, flutes, choir and a few synths.

sounds.name: Handpan Cycle
sounds.line: Handpan in D minor, a slow call and answer.

sounds.name: Starfall Glock
sounds.line: Glockenspiel with soft mallets, falling down the chord.

sounds.name: Drumming Wood
sounds.line: Marimba pattern that fills in a little more each bar.

sounds.name: Ocarina Song
sounds.line: Breathy ocarina playing a slow tune.

sounds.name: Prelude Marimba
sounds.line: Marimba on the Bach Prelude in C pattern, with ping-pong echo.

sounds.name: Glass Adagio
sounds.line: Tuned glasses, slow and ringing.

sounds.name: Additive Organ
sounds.line: Small pipe organ over a held bass note.

sounds.name: Romanza Guitar
sounds.line: Nylon guitar fingerpicking.

sounds.name: Orinoco Pizz
sounds.line: Cello pizzicato in a big hall, with echoes.

sounds.name: Whisper Lyre
sounds.line: Lyre with a fast, quiet tremolo.

sounds.name: Bright Gliss
sounds.line: Concert harp sweeping up the chord.

sounds.name: Osiris Nocturne
sounds.line: Upright piano, slow and quiet.

sounds.name: Pedal Waterfall
sounds.line: Grand piano falling down the chord, pedal down.

sounds.name: Tenth Lullaby
sounds.line: Soft upright piano, wide rolling chords.

sounds.name: Gate Pluck
sounds.line: Trance supersaw arp.

sounds.name: Pixel Run
sounds.line: Square-wave chip sound, fast runs up and down.

sounds.name: Horn Call
sounds.line: French horn going up and down the chord.

sounds.name: Tine Bloom
sounds.line: Tine electric piano, one spread chord a bar.

sounds.name: Neo-Soul Rhodes
sounds.line: Rhodes with syncopated neo-soul chords.

sounds.name: Kumbengo
sounds.line: Bright harp playing a kora pattern.

sounds.name: Rootless Vibes
sounds.line: Vibraphone with jazz chords.

sounds.name: Dayvan Tape
sounds.line: Warm synth on worn tape, long echoes.

sounds.name: Toccata Clav
sounds.line: Clavinet bouncing off the bass note.

sounds.name: Rokudan Shirabe
sounds.line: Japanese zither, koto-style picking.

sounds.name: Delay Spires
sounds.line: Clean electric guitar through a dotted-eighth delay.

sounds.name: Fishing Boat Glissandi
sounds.line: Guzheng sweeps, down then up.

sounds.name: Choir Entries
sounds.line: Choir coming in one voice at a time.

sounds.name: Sikuri Hocket
sounds.line: Two pan flutes trading notes.

sounds.name: Kotekan
sounds.line: Gamelan bronzes playing interlocking parts.

sounds.name: Sugar Plum Cascade
sounds.line: Celesta falling from the top, twice a bar.

sounds.name: Silver Flute
sounds.line: Breathy flute, one phrase a bar.

sounds.name: Harp Arabesque
sounds.line: Concert harp rolling up and down the chord.

sounds.name: Fox Night
sounds.line: CP80 electric grand, rippling chords.
